title: Trio SDK credential policy parity, stream-swap adapters, and ergonomic API polish
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: customers running mixed-language integrations reported subtle behavior drift between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs when short-lived credentials and long-lived streaming sessions are combined. This caused noisy retries and either token-exhausted stream failures or over-aggressive reauths. This PR unifies credential lease/refresh semantics, introduces a small "stream-swap" adapter that gracefully stitches a new stream instance during reauth, and applies ergonomic API surface polish across SDKs. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce a shared credential policy spec (TTL, prefetch jitter, backoff profile) and implement adapters in each SDK; 2) Add stream-swap adapter: a lightweight wrapper that allows an in-progress async iterator/stream consumer to transparently continue across credential rotation without forcing a reconnect from the application layer; 3) Align default backoff profiles and make them configurable via new RetryProfile type with presets (fast-retry, balanced, conservative); 4) Python: add AsyncStream.swap_on_auth(handler) method and small refactor to session manager to expose lease diagnostics; 5) TypeScript: add StreamHandle.swapOnAuth() and expose public RetryProfile enum; 6) Go: introduce StreamSwitcher interface and compact cred-cascade helper; 7) Update docs and examples (quickstart and streaming guides) and bump SDK versions: python 0.24.1, typescript 1.11.0, go 0.9.7. Backwards compatibility: default behaviours are preserved, migrations notes provided in release notes and in SDK CHANGELOGs. Testing: cross-language integration tests exercising token expiry during streaming; added unit tests for adapter swap semantics. Checklist: - [x] design doc (Linear ENG-8032) linked - [x] unit tests for each SDK - [x] e2e cross-language test harness run - [x] docs updated - [x] version bumps and package publish scripts updated Breaking changes: none expected; small API additions are additive and default runtime policy matches previous defaults. Rollout: feature gated by env var REDWOOD_SDK_STREAM_SWAP (off by default) for 2 weeks, then enabled by default after monitoring period.
